name: Alisha Ohl
bio: Associate Professor and Program Director of Occupational Therapy at Clarkson, where she has taught since 2016, serving as interim program director and department chair in 2020 before the permanent appointment. She previously taught OT at SUNY Downstate and spent five years as a senior occupational therapist and evaluator with the NYC Department of Education. Her research centers on OT practice with children and youth, including assessment psychometrics and the evidence base for school-based services.
